seo.home.description: Master Japanese with interactive quizzes: practice kana words, kanji readings, numbers, and dates. Track streaks, customize difficulty, and build fluency at your own pace.
seo.words.description: Practice reading and writing Japanese words in hiragana and katakana. Type each word in romaji, track your streak, and customize character groups and word length.
seo.kanji.description: Match kanji with their readings and meanings across JLPT levels N5 through N1. Practice on'yomi and kun'yomi with multiple-choice or typed answers.
seo.numbers.description: Practice writing Japanese numbers in kanji and reading kanji numbers as Arabic numerals, with flexible difficulty levels and keypad input.
seo.dates.description: Practice reading and writing Japanese dates. Learn days, months, weekdays, and full date readings with instant feedback and streak tracking.
heroSubtitle: Drill romaji for hiragana and katakana words with streaks, filters, and quick mode switching.
